entities.summary: British Mesopotamian, a notable figure in the history of Iraq, associated with British Mandate and Hashemite Kingdom (1914–1921). Preceded by WWI Conquest and 1920 Revolt and Faisal I installed as King of Iraq at the Cairo Conference. Their legacy influenced Iraq Petroleum Company and Hashemite Monarchy and Oil Economy.
